product_tiers.notes: Public and unlisted apps need Zoom Marketplace review; private/beta apps can skip.

summary: Create a Zoom OAuth app via the Zoom App Marketplace, configure redirect URIs, select scopes, and submit for review if the app is public or unlisted.

approval_wait.notes: Zoom does not publish exact review timeframes.

prerequisites.item: Zoom account with developer role (account owner, admin, or assigned Zoom for developers role)

steps.title: Log in to Zoom Developer Portal
steps.detail: Sign in at https://developers.zoom.us/ with a Zoom account that has the developer role.

steps.title: Create a new OAuth app
steps.detail: Navigate to Create an OAuth app page and click “Create”. Fill in app name, description, and select app type (user‑managed or account‑level).

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs
steps.detail: Add HTTPS redirect URIs; localhost URIs are allowed for testing but wildcards are not permitted.

steps.title: Select Scopes
steps.detail: Choose required scopes for the app. Sensitive scopes such as meeting:write will trigger a review.

steps.title: Save the app and obtain Client ID and Secret
steps.detail: After saving, the client ID and secret are displayed; store them securely.

steps.title: Test the OAuth flow in development mode
steps.detail: In development mode the app can be authorized by up to 10 users.

steps.title: Submit for review if app is public or unlisted
steps.detail: Provide required metadata, privacy policy, and security evidence; then submit via the Marketplace submission page.

scopes.purpose: Read meeting details of the authenticated user
Create, update, or delete meetings on behalf of the user
scopes.notes: Sensitive scope that requires Zoom Marketplace review.

blockers.issue: Public or unlisted apps require Zoom Marketplace review before they can be used by other users.
blockers.how_to_resolve: Complete the app submission form, provide privacy/security documentation, and wait for approval.

developer_must_do: create Zoom account with developer role
submit app for review if needed
